'''Animated black armour''' is a player-created foe encountered at the [[Warriors' Guild]]. To summon one, players must use a [[black platebody]], [[black platelegs]], and a [[black full helm]] on the [[magical animator]]. It is the best animated armour to kill for [[warrior token]]s, as it is the quickest to kill while also having no chance of losing any of the armour pieces.

A full set of black armour to animate can be easily and cheaply obtained by purchasing a black full helm from [[Valaine's Shop of Champions.|Valaine's Shop of Champions]], a black platebody from [[Horvik's Armour Shop.|Horvik's Armour Shop]], and black platelegs from [[Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar.]]

Like all other animated armour variants, it is immune to [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] attacks. As a result of being immune to Ranged damage, the armour is effectively immune to [[burn]], which will be inflicted but reduced to 0 damage. It is also immune to [[poison]] and [[venom]].
